steps.objective: Find the Ancient City of Brax
steps.brief: Deep in the mountains lies an ancient city that was buried under the earth due to some sort of catastrophe. At an ancient place, its origin forgotten, find entrance to the underground city. Within lurks something timeless and evil that must be stopped if the undead threat in Meridian is to be curtailed.

This is it. This place holds the source of the undead threat plaguing the land. Waves of evil radiate through the very air. Remain wary as you proceed further. The undead horrors of Brax hold secrets of an evil beyond time. It may be a never-ending quest to understand and resist the threat, but learn everything you can about Brax and how its Queen doomed it to sink under the earth. In the end, you may be forced to make a choice: fight, or serve.
